summary: __thiscall table lookup: computes an index from this[0] (a size/entry-count used as multiplier) and the float argument a2, reads a float from the buffer pointer stored at this[3], and scales it by 255.0 (constant in source; packet records the read of flt_59FEC8 as the associated multiplier). Existing analysis suggests a gamma/volume/alpha scaling curve, which is DERIVED only.

operations.description: Compute the table index: (int)((double)this[0] * a2), where this[0] is a float size/entry-count field read at +0x0.
Read the float value at this[3] + 8 * index, where this[3] is the buffer pointer read at +0xC and elements are stride 8.
Scale the looked-up float by 255.0; the packet records the read of flt_59FEC8 as the multiplier associated with this scaling.
Returns the scaled value as a double; no branches, always computes and returns.
Invoked by sub_55DA50 (0x0055DA50) and sub_55E320 (0x0055E320), consistent with a reusable curve-lookup helper.

unresolved: Whether flt_59FEC8 holds the 255.0 scale literal is DERIVED from the existing analysis (named AlphaChannelMultiplier), not confirmed.
The purpose of the table (gamma/volume/alpha) is proposed by existing analysis but not independently established.
Why the buffer stride is 8 for a 4-byte float entry is not explained.
